artworks.title: Prisoners on a Projecting Platform
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural space with arches and structures. The image features towering stone arches, bridges, steps, balustrades, and a large suspended sphere. Light and shadow create a dramatic atmosphere, highlighting stone textures and the complexity of the composition. The structures appear labyrinthine, guiding the viewer's gaze through winding paths and upward towards light filtering from above. Reflects Giovanni Battista Piranesi's style of grandiose imaginary prisons with elaborate architectural forms.

artworks.title: The Arch with a Shell Ornament
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, scratching, sulphur tint or open bite, drypoint
artworks.description: The image shows a series of intricate lines and arches intersecting across the composition, creating a network of curved and diagonal shapes. The design gives the appearance of a grand architectural structure, reminiscent of vaulted ceilings or bridges. The use of shadows and cross-hatching adds depth to the drawing, while elements like arched windows and stone blocks suggest a connection to classical or Romanesque architecture. In the foreground, a dark silhouette resembling a telescope or scaffolding is visible.

artworks.title: The Sawhorse
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, scratching
artworks.description: This is an image of an architectural fantasy scene. The drawing features a complex and intricate imagined architectural space with a large vaulted ceiling, steps leading up to a grand platform, and multiple arches and openings suggesting a labyrinthine interior. The illustration includes elaborate structural details such as ropes, large beams, and ladders, contributing to an atmosphere of grandeur and exploration. The setting feels like an imagined or fantastical space, similar to a vast, cavernous room or a monumental city interior, crafted with a high level of intricacy and detail.

artworks.title: The Well
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, scratching, burnishing, and lavis
artworks.description: The image shows an intricate arrangement of lines and shapes forming an architectural scene with staircases, columns, and arches. It has a labyrinthine structure with elements resembling ancient ruins and industrial mechanisms. The lines create shadows and depth, while rope-like shapes suggest pulley systems. Statues, urns, and figures are dispersed throughout the scene, evoking classical architecture and activity within this environment.

artworks.title: The Gothic Arch
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an intricate architectural fantasy. The composition showcases a network of massive, complex stone structures consisting of towering arches, staircases, and balconies connected by a maze of bridges and walkways. The perspective is skewed and dynamic, drawing the viewer into a labyrinth of shadow and light. This environment is articulated with a crosshatching technique, enhancing its depth and texture. The atmosphere of the piece is both monumental and eerie, highlighting the grandeur of this imaginary architectural space.

artworks.title: The Pier with a Lamp
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with arches and a decorative element. The drawing depicts large, curving arches and a pedestal-like structure adorned with intricate carvings and embellishments, including ring or hook-like ornaments. The cross-hatching technique adds texture and shading to the scene, creating a rich, textural quality. The atmosphere is dark with shadows throughout.

artworks.title: The Pier with Chains
artworks.medium: etching, engraving, sulphur tint or open bite, burnishing
artworks.description: The image is an interior architectural scene with Gothic-style arches, staircases, and a detailed column. Lanterns hang above a staircase, with two small figures in the distance. The color palette is monochromatic with black and white shades, emphasizing light and shadow play.

artworks.title: Charles I, King of England
artworks.artist: Lucas Emil Vorsterman after Sir Anthony van Dyck
artworks.description: The portrait depicts a man shown from the waist up. He has distinctive facial features, including a slightly elongated face, prominent cheekbones, and a well-groomed mustache and goatee. His hair is styled in loose curls that fall to his shoulders. He is dressed in a richly detailed garment, consisting of a patterned doublet with puffed sleeves and adorned with buttons. A large, intricately crafted ruff collar encircles his neck. The background is plain with fine horizontal lines.

artworks.title: The Mill
artworks.artist: Charles Turner after Rembrandt van Rijn
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated position looking across a gently sloping landscape towards a windmill in the center. The horizon is high, with the windmill on a mound against a clouded sky. Brushstrokes depict textures from the sky to the landscape. In the foreground, small figures and a rowboat are by the water, with the land sloping towards the windmill. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly gray.

artworks.title: Beggar's Opera, Act III
artworks.description: The image shows a room with stone walls, potentially a courtroom or meeting hall. In the foreground, figures are depicted standing and seated. Two men are engaged with seated women. One man wears a tricorn hat and formal coat, the other wears a similar outfit without a hat and a wig. The women wear dresses typical of the 18th century. On the left, a group of men in period attire observes the scene. On the right, more men are gathered behind a draped table. In the background, high walls with barred windows are visible. An elaborate frieze and banner stretch across the ceiling. Statues or figures are positioned in niches along the walls.

artworks.title: Leçon de Dessin (Drawing Lesson)
artworks.description: The engraving depicts a full view of two people, a woman seated and a man leaning towards her. The woman is sitting upright in profile, slightly turned toward the man, while holding a drawing board supported by a knee. Her facial features are delicate, with a gentle expression, and her hair is elegantly styled in an updo with ornate embellishments. She wears a long, detailed dress with lace trimmings, and a voluminous ruffled collar. The man stands upright beside her, with his body slightly bent forward. His hairstyle is neatly combed and parted, and he is dressed in a tailored coat with an elaborate cravat and high boots. Around them, there is a small table or bench, and the woman holds an artist's palette. In front, a plinth showcases a male bust, likely an artistic subject for their work, decorated with a sculpted laurel wreath. Additionally, there are a couple of drawing portfolios leaning against the pedestal. The background is neutral.

artworks.title: Leçon de Musique (Music Lesson)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman seated, playing a harp, and a man standing with a violin. The woman is in profile view, wearing an elegant dress, and the man is in formal attire. The scene includes a music stand and a stool with a top hat.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child with a Bell
artworks.dimensions:
plate (diameter): 4 cm (1 9/16 in.)
sheet (diameter): 4.4 cm (1 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a woman holding a child, both with halos above their heads. The woman is seated with the child on her lap, both facing slightly to the side. The woman has long flowing hair and a gentle expression, and wears a draped garment. The child is naked with curly hair and reaches out with one arm. There is a chair or throne-like element with decorative designs, and a simple background with linear elements suggesting clouds.

artworks.title: Dance in a Madhouse
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene featuring a ballroom dance. The scene shows figures dancing in the foreground, with onlookers in the background. The painting uses dark tones and strong contrasts to create an intense atmosphere. The room is richly textured with dim lighting, similar to the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Prayer Meeting, second stone
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered in an elegant interior illuminated by wall-mounted lamps. The room features an upright piano on the left side with sheet music and papers on it. In the center, a figure gesticulates underneath a sculpture atop a pedestal. The scene has onlookers seated in rows, dressed in formal attire. Shadows and lighting create contrast, emphasizing the interaction in the room. The backdrop suggests a drawing room with windows and chairs.

artworks.title: Pride
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the upper back to the thighs, sitting with their back turned slightly towards the viewer. Their head is turned to the side, showing a partial view of their face. They have long, wavy hair, a rounded face, and are holding a round object in one hand towards a group of birds. The person appears unclothed, with a draped fabric around their lower body. The background has hatched lines for texture and the ground looks grassy.

artworks.title: Solomon's Idolatry
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted in the foreground. The first person, a bearded man, is seated facing right wearing a long robe. He has a beard, thinning hair, and a prominent nose. A woman stands beside him wearing an elaborate gown and an ornate headdress. She leans toward the man with her hands on his shoulders. A female figure, resembling a statue, stands on a pedestal to the right, looking towards the pair. The background shows architectural elements like an archway and brick patterns.

artworks.title: Pietà (the "Christ of Caprarola")
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures in a composed scene. The central person, reclining with eyes closed, is held by another leaning over them. The reclining figure has an exposed torso and draped fabric around their hips, curly hair, and a serene expression. On the left, two other individuals are seated close together. The figures are clothed in loose drapery, creating folds and textures. The background includes a cross-shaped structure on the right and a sketched landscape. The monochrome tones and detailed linework convey a classical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Titian
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 32.9 x 23.5 cm (12 15/16 x 9 1/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image displays an elderly man in a three-quarter view, focusing on his head and shoulders. He is turned slightly to his right, gazing forward and slightly upward. The man has a notable forehead, deep-set eyes, and a long beard. His head is covered by a snug cap, and he wears a garment with a fur collar that frames his face and covers his shoulders. Underneath the fur, he has a buttoned undergarment. The background is plain, with fine horizontal lines that indicate it may be an engraved portrait.

artworks.title: Lady in Black, in a Loge, Facing Right
artworks.description: The image displays the upper half of a seated woman's body from the side. She is sitting in a profile position, facing right with short dark hair partly covered by a small hat or headpiece. She wears a dark outfit and holds an open fan in her hand. The background shows horizontal bands resembling a theater or opera house setting, with indistinct faces hinting at a crowd.

artworks.title: Afternoon Promenade
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image is an etching of a woman standing upright. She is turned slightly to the side with her hands clasped in front of her. The woman has softly rendered facial features and styled hair, partially covered with a cap or bonnet. She wears a long skirt, a dark jacket, and a light-colored scarf around her neck. There is no visible jewelry or objects in her hands. The background is a plain surface that emphasizes the figure.

artworks.title: The Corner of the Sofa (No. 3)
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an artwork of a person extending from the torso up to the head. The person is slightly turned to their left, with their head slightly tilted. The facial features are softly sketched, with indistinct expressions. The individual's hair is short and tucked under a hat with a decorative band. The person wears a high-collared garment, possibly a coat or dress, with visible details of a tied neckpiece. They appear to be seated on a textured surface, possibly a cushion or upholstery. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background consists of a dark section on one side and a lighter textured section on the other.

artworks.title: The Sign Painter (Le Peintre d'Enseignes)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated in front of an easel with a canvas. The individual is engaged in painting, dressed in a long coat, trousers, and boots. They hold a painter's palette in their left hand and a brush in their right hand, with various items around them.

artworks.title: Bahnhof Tiergarten (Court with Trees)
artworks.description: The image shows a row of trees with vertical trunks at the top of the frame. Behind the trees are dark structures, possibly buildings. The horizon is slightly above the center, with buildings merging with the tree trunks. The scene is monochromatic with bold brushstrokes showing tree details and building shadows. Figures and a small animal are drawn closest to us. The drawing style suggests movement and spontaneity, with black ink on a light background.
